description.value: Umbrella Café sits at the base of the Morrisey and Orient chairlifts inside Sun Peaks Resort, a four-season mountain destination with an active bike park. The cafe features 360-degree windows, a retractable roof, outdoor seating, and fire pits, offering coffee, beer, hot dogs, deli sandwiches, and baked goods in a relaxed alpine setting. For mountain-bike tourists using Sun Peaks' trail network, it is a convenient mid-ride refuelling stop at the lift base.

address.value: Base of Mt. Morrisey, 3150 Creekside Way, Sun Peaks, BC
